name: Scottish Highlands & Isle of Skye
about: May–Sep has the best weather and long daylight, though midges (biting insects) are a real nuisance Jun–Aug; winter brings short days and closed trails.
overview: Lochs, castles, and single-track roads through the Highlands, connected by bridge to Skye's dramatic sea cliffs and peaks.
costOverview: Coffee and a casual pub meal are reasonable — a whisky distillery tour and tasting is a real, worthwhile splurge most visitors build a day around.

specialSeasons.text: Midges — tiny biting insects — are out in force, especially at dawn and dusk near still water. Bring repellent.
